$comment: Release-candidate identity for the PMI local candidate. This file is deliberately NOT in SHA256SUMS, together with REPRODUCTION_RECEIPT.json: a file cannot contain the digest of the commit that contains it. The candidate's identity is therefore content-addressed (payload manifest) plus an annotated tag, not a self-referential hash. Publication status is governed by PUBLICATION_DECISION.md.
title: Ratings Are Not Forecasts: Accounting, Calibration, and Information Timing in NBA Player-Impact Forecasting
author: Geoffrey Hadfield
